title: Root Workspace Dependencies And Registrar Protocol
description: W0 mechanism-preparation slice of CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE (master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE). Purely additive: introduce [workspace.package] and [workspace.dependencies] to root Cargo.toml (canonical externals + internal path deps for existing high-fanout crates), try glob members alongside the literal 608, and append a Registrar Protocol section to the master ticket doc. No crates moved/renamed. Verify with cargo metadata / cargo check / bun script.ts verify gate.
summary:
W0 mechanism-prep slice of CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE. Purely additive root Cargo.toml change — zero crates moved, zero existing member lines touched, Cargo.lock untouched.

Survey (Task 1): grepped all 630 Cargo.toml files for the highest-fanout externals. Canonical versions picked as the newest explicit requirement string already in use (matches what Cargo.lock already resolves to): serde 1.0.228 (features=["derive"]), serde_json 1.0.149, wasm-bindgen 0.2.106, thiserror 2.0.18, tokio "1" (no fixed features — usage is too heterogeneous across ~20 manifests, left for consumers to add their own feature list via `workspace = true`), ts-rs "10" (only 2 manifests use it — below the ~10-manifest bar but included since both agree and it's on the explicit survey list). wgpu confirmed NOT a direct dep anywhere outside the ui crate (🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🧊️wgpu) — skipped per the task's own instruction.

Added [workspace.package]: version 0.1.0, edition 2021, rust-version 1.88 — all three values are the unanimous value across essentially every one of the 622/613 manifests that set them (one lone package-version outlier at 0.30.12, harmless since nothing inherits yet).

Added [workspace.dependencies] internal path deps (Task 3): wrote a script counting `path = "…"` references across all manifests, resolved each target's real `[package] name`, kept every crate referenced by >5 other manifests (101 entries, zero name collisions, zero missing names) — grouped into os-kernel/core (24), math (13), ui (2), and plugin-internal (62, e.g. norm_core referenced 52x, store 359x, protocol 218x, dsl 206x).

Task 4 (glob members): tested cargo's glob-member support with emoji path segments in an isolated scratch workspace — the emoji syntax itself parses fine, but Cargo hard-errors when a glob matches zero directories, which every future-shape glob does today (no crate has moved yet in W0). Skipped per the task's own fallback instruction; documented in the Registrar Protocol section instead as something a later batch's registrar adds incrementally once real matching dirs exist.

Task 5: appended a "Registrar Protocol" section (~6 bullet points) to the master ticket doc, covering: single serialized registrar for root Cargo.toml/lock in W1-W3, migrating agents never touch root files, the per-batch sequence, why globs aren't wired up yet, opt-in `.workspace = true` adoption, and red-gate blocking the next batch.

Verification: `cargo metadata` — clean. `cargo check -p semio-framework-core -p semio-framework-plugin` — clean (1 pre-existing unrelated warning). `cargo check --workspace` — clean except ONE pre-existing, unrelated compile error in `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/🎛️apps/🗂️curate/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs` (mismatched delimiter around line 382) — outside my ownership, looks like a live concurrent edit, not caused by this change (my diff never touches any plugin file). `bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate` — dependency-cruiser, registry-catalog-freshness, region/host-contract lint, plugin capability lint, and no-px check all passed; it then fails at the framework-core ts-rs binding-freshness step, root-caused (reproduced standalone, unrelated to my change) to a pre-existing cwd bug in `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts`'s `runTypegenExportTest`/`bindingsDir`/`generatedManifestPath` — they assume a `root/rs`, `root/js` bundle layout that framework-core's crate (flat: Cargo.toml/lib.rs/bindings/ directly at root) doesn't have; flagged as a separate background task (task_e3b1b341) since it's outside this ticket's file ownership. `git diff Cargo.lock` — empty, zero changes, as expected since nothing references `.workspace = true` yet.
